def precompute_remediations(remediations: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]],
    packages: Dict[str, Package], vulns: List[Vulnerability],
    secure_vulns_by_user: set) ->None:
    
    for vuln in vulns:
        if vuln.ignored:
            continue
            
        pkg_name = vuln.package_name
        pkg = vuln.pkg
        
        if pkg_name not in packages:
            packages[pkg_name] = pkg
            
        # Add remediation info for this package and requirement
        req_str = str(vuln.analyzed_requirement.specifier)
        if req_str not in remediations[pkg_name]:
            remediations[pkg_name][req_str] = {
                'vulnerabilities_found': 0,
                'version': vuln.analyzed_version,
                'requirement': vuln.analyzed_requirement,
                'more_info_url': vuln.more_info_url
            }
            
        # Increment vulnerability count
        remediations[pkg_name][req_str]['vulnerabilities_found'] += 1
